courses.title: Online Meditation Groups
courses.description: Ongoing meditation groups that Linda Hall leads on Zoom for people with some experience who want to practise regularly with others. Sessions include guided visualisation, body awareness for relaxation, mindfulness for stress, colour energy work and the chakras.

left_out: One-to-one meditation sessions (lindahallmeditation.com/one-to-one-meditation-sessions, £150.00 / £120.00): the page presents meditation as 'one of the better therapies' for anxiety disorders, depression, OCD, panic attacks, sleep problems and high blood pressure; a treatment claim for medical conditions, so still out.

Insight Timer courses (Overcome Anxiety At Work, How To Restore Sound Sleep, Protect Your Body From Daily Stress, Chakra Healing For Spiritual & Psychological Health): Insight Timer is never fetched, so their current pages could not be checked.
